We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (from make_8_lvl2-template_search-4) to the molecule given in make_8_lvl2-apply_template-3 answer. The answer from apply_template-3 gave two SMILES (maybe product molecules?). Actually those are likely the target molecule? The question: "Can you return all possible precursors of applying the template as the result of the task make_8_lvl2-template_search-3 to the molecule below?" The answer gave list of SMILES: two molecules (maybe product). Now we need to apply the template (template_id 1141) to each of those molecules to get precursors.

We have tool apply_template which takes molecule_smiles and template_id. Template ID format likely "template_1141"? The template_id from search is numeric 1141. The tool expects string like "template_123". So we need to use "template_1141". Let's apply to each SMILES.

First SMILES: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)C(=O)C1"

Second: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1=O"

We apply template 1141. Let's call apply_template.
